answer_4.quote: students were asked every week if the tutor had made some errors in their chats. Of 160 responses, only 16 indicated a problem. Going over all the marked exercises, we concluded that there were no more than 14 utterances that could be considered problematic.
answer_4.guideline: Questionnaires included Likert scale questions on usefulness, interestingness, comprehensiveness, level_of_resources, and open-ended questions about anomalies and helpful aspects.
